category_edits.rationale: Test a 3.25-interaction pooling half-life across all four datasets. This explores slightly slower decay around the incumbent three after shorter half-lives regressed. Retain the 0.8/0.2 causal readout blend and synchronize predictor metadata.

response.change_summary: Change only causal pooling half-life from 3 to 3.25 and synchronize checkpoint metadata with the embedded predictor. Preserve one GRU4Rec model per category and existing training limits.
